# Munnar Holidays

> Complete travel guide for Munnar, Kerala's premier hill station, featuring tour packages, luxury resorts, trekking adventures, and multi-destination Kerala itineraries combining tea plantations, backwaters, and beaches.

Munnar Holidays specializes in curated experiences across Kerala's Western Ghats region, offering everything from budget-friendly 3-day getaways to luxury 6-day tours. The site features handpicked accommodations ranging from eco-retreats to premium tree house resorts, plus adventure activities like trekking to Meesapulimala Peak and camping experiences.

## Key Topics

- Munnar hill station
- Kerala tour packages
- Tea plantations and estates
- Alleppey houseboat cruises
- Fort Kochi cultural tours
- Eravikulam National Park
- Western Ghats trekking
- Thekkady wildlife safari
- Premium resorts and tree houses
- Kerala backwaters
- Honeymoon packages
- Ayurvedic spa retreats
- Adventure camping
- Kumarakom backwaters
- Mattupetty Dam

## Multi-Destination Kerala Tour Packages

- [Munnar Backwaters and Beach Holiday](https://munnar.holiday/packages/munnar-backwaters-and-beach-holiday-tour-package): 6-day Kerala tour: Munnar hills, Kumarakom/Alleppey backwaters & beaches
- [Munnar Houseboat Kerala Holiday Package](https://munnar.holiday/packages/munnar-houseboat-kerala-holiday-package): 4-day package: Munnar tea estates, Alleppey houseboat & Fort Kochi
- [Luxury Munnar Houseboat Package](https://munnar.holiday/packages/luxury-munnar-houseboat--tour-package): 4-day luxury tour: Munnar hills, Alleppey houseboat & Kochi sightseeing
- [Mesmerizing Kerala](https://munnar.holiday/packages/mesmerizing-kerala-tour-package): Multi-day Kerala tour: Munnar hills, backwaters, waterfalls & coast
- [Amazing Kerala](https://munnar.holiday/packages/amazing-kerala): Multi-day Kerala tour: Munnar, Kochi, Alleppey houseboat & beaches
- [Munnar & Thekkady Combo](https://munnar.holiday/packages/munnar-thekkady-combo): 5-day combo: Munnar tea estates & Thekkady Periyar wildlife safari
- [Simply Munnar](https://munnar.holiday/packages/simply-munnar): 3-day package: Kochi, Munnar tea gardens & Fort Kochi culture

## Premium Resorts and Accommodations

- [Kaivalyam Retreat Tree House Munnar](https://munnar.holiday/hotels/kaivalyam-retreat-tree-house-munnar): Premium tree house resort in Pallivasal with yoga & organic wellness
- [Spice Garden Resort](https://munnar.holiday/hotels/spice-garden-resort): Luxury resort in Chinnakanal with spice plantation & Ayurvedic spa
- [Plum Judy Munnar](https://munnar.holiday/hotels/plum-judy-munnar): Premium hill-view resort in Pallivasal with spa & tea plantation views
- [Deepwoods Resort Munnar](https://munnar.holiday/hotels/deepwoods-resort-munnar): Forest resort on 40-acre cardamom plantation with nature immersion
- [Spicetree](https://munnar.holiday/hotels/spicetree): Premium Western Ghats mountain resort with colonial charm & spa
- [Green Valley Resort](https://munnar.holiday/hotels/green-valley-resort): Adventure resort in Devikulam with trekking & bonfire facilities
- [Mistle toe Munnar](https://munnar.holiday/hotels/mistle-toe-munnar-resort): Boutique homestay in Iruttukanam with bakery & cooking classes
- [Eco Tunes Munnar](https://munnar.holiday/hotels/eco-tunes-munnar): Eco-friendly nature retreat in Anachal tea plantation area

## Adventure and Trekking Experiences

- [Meesapulimala Munnar Adventure Trek](https://munnar.holiday/packages/meesapulimala-munnar-adventure-trek): Guided day trek to Meesapulimala Peak via tea gardens & forests
- [Lakshmi Hills Munnar Trekking Tour](https://munnar.holiday/packages/lakshmi-hills-munnar-trekking-tour): Scenic day trek through tea plantations to Lakshmi Hills ridge
- [Munnar Camping Packages](https://munnar.holiday/p/munnar-camping): Camping packages with tents, campfire & optional trekking in Munnar
